summary: Execution traces as gradients (Trace/OptoPrime: workflow execution traces propagate as minimal subgraphs to interchangeable optimizers; only explicitly trainable nodes may change; feedback in scores, words, test failures, or compiler errors flows back; bounded review slices with a slower narrower fallback past the context bound; adopted as a review discipline, never unattended self-rewriting) + content-addressed DAG session history with test-gated patch selection (agent-merge: immutable events addressed by SHA-256 content hash, steps forming a DAG, branches as named pointers, context materialization as a pure function of traversal; only test-passing patches eligible, smallest passing patch wins, failed rounds feed back for repair, losing branches' annotations survive, deterministic bisect for fault localization) + provider-agnostic orchestration (OmniNode: providers behind one contract with normalized errors, zero vendor dependencies in the core; DAG pipeline scheduling; report aggregation preserving both sides of a conflict; memory contract with budgeted retrieval; atomic writes, corruption quarantine, never destroying a newer store file; inline-secret refusal). Patterns restated in our own words only; no code, no network/wallet/signing/payment/API-key code, no benchmark, speed, audit, star-count, or deployment claims as fact.
